cohort: Three antenatal patients presenting with obstructed labour caused by large urinary bladder calculi.
finding: A large urinary bladder calculus should be considered a rare cause of obstructed labour, and early diagnosis and timely management can prevent complications like mechanical dystocia and Vesico-vaginal Fistula.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed for obstructed labour in all three cases, alongside a cystolithotomy.
